Shadow-Cursed Pilgrims are a type of undead creature which may appear in the Shadow-Cursed Lands during Act Two. They are pilgrims who have been taken by the shadow curse and turned into mindless creatures.

Involvement

Act Two

Shadow-Cursed Pilgrims appear once  Halsin opens a portal to the Shadowfell during ⁠Lift the Shadow Curse. The party must defend the portal while various shadow creatures, including Shadow-Cursed Pilgrims, attempt to attack it.
